title: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken and Rice
ingredients: 1½ lbs boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Toss the chicken pieces with the garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until coated.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large pan over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until golden-brown with caramelized edges. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, melt the remaining 2 tbsp butter and sauté the minced garlic until fragrant.
Stir in the rice and toast for 1 minute, then pour in the chicken broth. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for about 18 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Pour in the heavy cream and stir in the cream cheese until smooth and melted.
Add the mozzarella and Parmesan, stirring until the sauce turns thick, glossy, and velvety, coating every grain of rice.
Fold the seared chicken back in until fully combined and heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve.
notes: One-pan meal. The sauce should be thick and glossy before adding the chicken back.
